explanation: A digitization method that applies the relation z=e^{sT} to the poles and zeros of a transfer function. Steps: 1) Map poles and zeros according to z=e^{sT}. 2) If numerator is lower order than denominator, add powers of (z+1) to equalize order. 3) Set DC or low-frequency gain of D_d(z) equal to that of D_c(s).
